style.backgroundSystem: seamless warm off-white #F7F5F1 for packshots, spec and variant screens; deep charcoal #141414 for claim, trust and closing screens; mid charcoal #3A3A3A for pain-point and comparison panels
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons and thin round outline labels in one accent #C6A15B only
style.lightingSystem: warm balanced soft diffused key light with soft fill and soft contact shadows, controlled low speculars, no harsh rim flare, consistent direction across the whole set
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium automotive-interior soft-goods visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep charcoal #141414, warm off-white #F7F5F1, charcoal text #2B2B2B and one muted gold accent #C6A15B; warm balanced soft diffused lighting with soft fill and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines; consistent thin round outline labels and rounded info panels; consistent thin-line icon style in the single accent #C6A15B; clean high-end soft-goods product photography on seamless backgrounds mixed with minimal dark infographic elements; stable contoured-cushion scale and placement with no visible automotive brand badges or branded wordmarks anywhere; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no branded wordmarks or character artwork
style.presentationRules: stable contoured-cushion scale and centering, same hero angle family across set, product never clipped and never floating without a contact shadow, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout
style.surfaceSystem: matte woven fabric texture and matte charcoal board #2B2B2B, plain unbranded seat material #C8B9A6 for in-cabin shots
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal #2B2B2B on light panels and warm off-white #F7F5F1 on dark panels
